finding.claim: Checkout follows symlinks created earlier in the same tree (or existing in the worktree), so a malicious repo can write attacker-chosen files outside the work tree on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS APFS default, Windows NTFS, case-insensitive mounts).
finding.source: Remote repository tree content: a symlink entry 'A' (mode 120000, target an existing victim directory such as ~/Library/LaunchAgents) and a blob 'a/<file>' in the same tree. Reached via clone (client.py:1470 checkout=True, client.py:1598 reset_index), branch switch (worktree.py:792, index.py:3056), and submodule update (porcelain/submodule.py:254).
finding.sink: index.py:1916 open(target_path,'wb') in build_file_from_blob; index.py:1902 symlink creation; index.py:2229-2232 os.path.exists/os.makedirs on dirname; porcelain/submodule.py:226-242 makedirs and open(git_file_path,'w'); porcelain/submodule.py:254-260 build_index_from_tree.

trace.note: clone checkout calls reset_index on the fetched repo
validator derived from config; protectNTFS defaults to true, selecting validate_path_element_ntfs
iter_tree_contents iterates subentries with iteritems(name_order=True), so symlink 'A' is yielded before 'a/...' because 'A' (0x41) sorts before 'a' (0x61)
validate_path checks each path element by name only; 'A' and 'a' both pass
full_path computed; os.path.exists(dirname) follows symlinks on a case-insensitive FS, so makedirs is skipped for 'a/'
build_file_from_blob called for the symlink entry 'A'
for later entry a/x: lstat(root/a/x) returns ENOENT, so oldstat is None
only the leaf path is checked for being a symlink; intermediate components are not
open(root/a/x,'wb') resolves root/a to root/A and writes into the victim directory

finding.guards_checked: validate_path_element_ntfs (index.py:2078-2100), validate_path_element_default (index.py:2019-2028), validate_path_element_hfs (index.py:2124-2145): name/dot-name checks only, no case or normalization collision detection. validate_path (index.py:2171-2181): per-element name check. build_file_from_blob (index.py:1904-1910): checks only whether the leaf is already a symlink. No lstat/realpath/islink check on leading path components in index.py, worktree.py, or porcelain/submodule.py. _transition_to_file (index.py:2552-2602) has the same gap. porcelain/submodule.py:90-110 validates path names only. Not executed: verified by reading only.
